stories.title: WTT中国大满贯赛：国乒七名选手获得正赛席位

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam: Seven Chinese Players Secure Main Draw Spots
en.summary: Seven Chinese table tennis players qualified for the main draw of the 2026 WTT China Grand Slam after qualifying round matches in Beijing. The group includes two men's singles players and five women's singles players.

stories.title: Probe launched into luxury One Stanley project over alleged steel bar shortage

en.title: Probe launched into luxury One Stanley project over alleged steel bar shortage
en.summary: Hong Kong authorities are investigating building quality at the luxury One Stanley residential development following complaints about insufficient steel bars used during construction. Previous inspections found no imminent safety danger.

stories.title: 工业母机产业链如何高质量发展？院士专家共议新路径

en.title: How can the industrial machine tool industry achieve high-quality development? Academicians and experts discuss new pathways
en.summary: Chinese engineering experts discussed development strategies for the industrial machine tool sector, with emphasis on using artificial intelligence to enhance numerical control machine tools for technological innovation.

stories.title: 专家：50岁以上慢病人群假期出行前 需做好带状疱疹风险评估

en.title: Experts: Those over 50 with chronic diseases should assess shingles risk before holiday travel
en.summary: Health experts recommend that middle-aged and elderly people with chronic conditions conduct health risk assessments before holiday travel, as travel-related disruptions to routines and immune system changes increase health vulnerabilities.

stories.title: 国际能源署：已释放约3.25亿桶战略石油储备

en.title: International Energy Agency: Approximately 3.25 billion barrels of strategic petroleum reserves released
en.summary: The International Energy Agency announced it has released approximately 3.25 billion barrels of the 4 billion barrels of strategic petroleum reserves it planned to release in March this year.

stories.title: 改革激活创新源力 产业集聚硬核势能 陕西培育壮大新质生产力

en.title: Reform activates innovation vitality; industrial clustering builds core momentum; Shaanxi cultivates and develops new quality productive forces
en.summary: Shaanxi is reforming education, science, technology and talent systems to develop advanced industries including photonics and new energy equipment, with universities and research teams working together to translate laboratory achievements into commercial products.

stories.title: 我国多举措支持服务业扩能提质

en.title: China implements multiple measures to support service industry expansion and quality improvement
en.summary: China is promoting service sector growth through policies supporting professional services in production and expanded consumer services in areas like elderly care, with land and financial support directing resources to strategic industries. Service sector contributed 66.1% to economic growth in the first half of the year.

stories.title: 通胀冲击历史性升温，日本民众餐桌承压

en.title: Inflation surge at historic levels; Japanese households' dining tables under pressure
en.summary: Japanese companies are currently raising prices in response to historically elevated inflation affecting consumer purchasing.

stories.title: 我国首个深水油田流花油田取得新突破 “国之重器”协同运转

en.title: China's First Deepwater Oil Field Achieves New Breakthrough, "National Strategic Asset" Operates in Coordination
en.summary: China's Liuhua deepwater oil field, the country's first, reached a cumulative production milestone of 2 million tonnes from its secondary development project. The field has produced over 40 million tonnes total and achieved its highest daily output in 22 years of operation, strengthening China's energy security.

stories.title: 美国咖啡品牌新疆开店受欢迎

en.title: American Coffee Brand's Xinjiang Store Attracts Customers
en.summary: Starbucks has opened its first location in Urumqi, Xinjiang, featuring region-inspired beverages and merchandise. A Shanghai tourist visiting the store purchased a drink inspired by the local Sailimu Lake and a souvenir doll dressed in traditional Xinjiang clothing.

stories.title: 中国选手袁思俊晋级2026世界斯诺克·深圳公开赛决赛

en.title: Chinese player Yuan Sijun advances to 2026 World Snooker Shenzhen Open final
en.summary: Yuan Sijun of China defeated England's Jimmy Robertson 6-5 in the first semifinal of the 2026 World Snooker Shenzhen Open on October 3, securing a place in the final.

stories.title: 中国香港队夺首届FIFA东盟挑战杯冠军 主教练称感觉“非常美妙”

en.title: Hong Kong China wins inaugural FIFA ASEAN Challenge Cup championship; head coach says feeling "wonderful"
en.summary: Hong Kong China defeated Cambodia 2-0 in the final of the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Challenge Cup on October 3 at Hong Kong's Kai Tak Sports Park to claim the championship.

stories.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales

en.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales
en.summary: Wuhan has become the fourth major Chinese city after Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou to shift towards completed-home sales. Property analysts expect this supply-side transformation to reshape China's housing market structure rather than immediately boost homebuyer demand.

stories.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts

en.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts
en.summary: Ping An Bank became the first listed Chinese bank to formally adopt artificial intelligence governance rules, with analysts predicting other mainland financial institutions will follow suit as regulators push for stronger AI oversight in the sector.

stories.title: McDonald’s sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as ‘old money’ returns to retail

en.title: McDonald's sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as 'old money' returns to retail
en.summary: McDonald's has sold a Hong Kong property housing its first New Territories restaurant for HK$120 million to Keen Charm Holdings, continuing its year-long divestment of self-owned locations as traditional wealth re-enters the retail property market.

stories.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city’s 5-year plan

en.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city's 5-year plan
en.summary: Hong Kong Investment Corporation's CEO Clara Chan has been reappointed for three additional years through October 2029, as the government-backed fund managing HK$62 billion supports emerging industries aligned with the city's five-year development strategy.

stories.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin

en.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin
en.summary: Ten developers submitted bids for Hong Kong's sole residential site in the latest government land sale programme before Friday's deadline. Major firms including Chinachem Group, Wheelock Properties, Kerry Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties competed for the Fat Kwong Street site in Ho Man Tin.
